decisions.reason: The building data digital twin service still matches the firm's strategic direction, but because it is more implementation- and market-intensive than the other options we would retain it only as a cautious growth option for now.

After another year, this authentication and identity delegation service looks too overlapping and insufficiently distinctive relative to adjacent identity offerings, so the option is no longer attractive enough to keep open.

The open GIS application development framework is tightly linked to the firm's core capabilities and ecosystem logic, and as a product line it preserves valuable follow-on options at relatively low ongoing cost.

The identity and access service for GIS applications remains strategically coherent with broader enterprise integration and appears to be the stronger of the firm's identity-related options, so we would continue it.
The geodata business process consulting workshop is very close to the established consulting business and inexpensive to keep on offer while demand becomes clearer, so it should be retained.
